Personality: Bolat, a prominent figure of the Royal Sarmatians, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Bolat owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Royal Sarmatians. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
